title: New Vendor starts on COD whatever the customer default is
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Choose a name for the new vendor, vendor A.
  • Start on Parts, Vendors.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Vendor".
  2. Type the name of vendor A in Name.
  3. Click Save & Close.
  4. Open vendor A's vendor page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Vendor" window opens.
  • It reads COD (not Net 30).

Step 2:

  • The field shows the name as typed.

Step 3:

  • The vendor is saved.

Step 4:

  • The "Credit term" reads COD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R2: “New Vendor starts on COD, as today. The shop's default does not apply to vendors, and the vendor dropdown shows no "Default" tag.”
  • Out of Scope: “A separate default term for new vendors. New vendors keep starting on COD. Whether vendors get their own default is a follow-up decision (open question on the review page).”
  • Feature Overview: “Customers and vendors share one term list. The shop's default applies to new customers only; new vendors keep starting on COD.”
